supporting_article_titles: FTC opens probe into AI giants including Anthropic and OpenAI
Yapay zekâ devlerinden Beyaz Saray’da güvenlik mutabakatı
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Frontier AI agent safety moved from voluntary lab practice toward formal consumer-protection investigation and outside-audit expectations after rogue-agent incidents.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: agent release → capability/sandbox test → evidence capture → external review → deployment approval
raw_opportunities.buyer: AI governance, security or risk lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: prove before deployment that an autonomous agent stayed within permissions and that required safety controls were tested
raw_opportunities.current_friction: agent tests, permissions, incident traces and approvals are fragmented across engineering/security artifacts
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: vendor-neutral agent safety evidence register with test-case inventory, permission boundary checklist, incident trace links, remediation and approval record
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight evidence desk for teams to document and approve agent safety tests before production.
raw_opportunities.why_now: FTC opened a formal probe into AI labs over potential consumer harms while major labs also accepted outside safety audits.

supporting_article_titles: We asked five AI tools to build accessible websites. All 15 sites failed.
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: AI website builders can rapidly ship pages while systematically reproducing accessibility defects; all 15 tested sites failed WCAG Level A despite accessibility instructions.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI-generated site → pre-publish accessibility check → defect assignment → remediation evidence → release
raw_opportunities.target_customer: small teams and agencies shipping websites with AI/vibe-coding tools
raw_opportunities.buyer: agency owner, product lead or web developer
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: catch accessibility failures in AI-generated sites before publishing and retain proof of remediation
raw_opportunities.current_friction: teams trust generated code and discover keyboard/screen-reader failures late or after complaints
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: URL/page inventory plus free automated accessibility scan import, manual keyboard/screen-reader checklist, severity queue, remediation owner and evidence export
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: An accessibility release gate designed specifically for AI-generated websites.
raw_opportunities.why_now: A 2026 test found all 15 AI-generated sites failed basic WCAG Level A and 91% of issues were medium/high severity.

supporting_article_titles: Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Long-running agent workflows expose failure/retry/reproducibility problems that were less acute in short deterministic software calls.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: agent task → multi-step tool execution → failure/retry → human escalation → outcome audit
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: know which agent jobs are stuck, duplicated or partially completed and recover them safely
raw_opportunities.current_friction: agent actions can span many steps and unpredictable paths; a mid-process failure can leave unclear business state
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: application-level run ledger over existing agent/webhook systems: step status, idempotency key, checkpoint, retry/escalation queue and outcome reconciliation
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A no-infrastructure agent run control desk for SMB automations.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Restate reports strong demand for durable execution as agent workflows become longer and less predictable.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Factories and logistics operators using agentic back-office workflows could use the same run/recovery ledger without plant integration.

supporting_article_titles: 7 in 10 enterprises expected to abandon vendor-built agentic AI by 2028
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Enterprises face growing lock-in and maintainability risk from vendor-built agent systems that depend on outside forward-deployed expertise.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: agent procurement → vendor implementation → knowledge transfer → dependency review → exit/replace decision
raw_opportunities.target_customer: enterprises buying custom or vendor-built agentic AI
raw_opportunities.buyer: CIO, procurement, enterprise architecture or AI program lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: measure whether an agent deployment can be operated, changed and exited without the vendor
raw_opportunities.current_friction: ownership of prompts, tools, credentials, data mappings, runbooks and operational knowledge is often unclear until exit becomes costly
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: agent vendor portability register scoring artifact ownership, exportability, credential control, runbook coverage, internal skills and exit readiness
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A vendor-exit readiness scorecard for enterprise AI-agent deployments.
raw_opportunities.why_now: The Register reports an expectation that seven in ten enterprises will abandon vendor-built agentic AI by 2028, highlighting dependency risk.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Industrial companies procuring vendor AI can apply the same ownership and exit checklist.

supporting_article_titles: 500 appareils sont concernés : un sous-traitant de Leonardo plombe la qualité du fuselage des A321neo d’Airbus
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: A second-tier supplier process deviation propagated into roughly 500 aircraft, exposing how supplier/process evidence can become a fleet-scale containment problem.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: supplier process/spec → lot shipment → incoming/production use → defect discovery → affected-lot trace → containment/corrective action
raw_opportunities.target_customer: manufacturers with multi-tier supplier quality chains
raw_opportunities.buyer: supplier quality manager or quality director
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: trace a newly discovered supplier-process deviation to affected lots/products and coordinate containment evidence
raw_opportunities.current_friction: second-tier process evidence and lot genealogy are often split across email, spreadsheets, ERP attachments and supplier portals
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: supplier deviation case ledger linking supplier/process/spec, affected lots, downstream products, containment actions, evidence and closure approvals
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight supplier-deviation containment desk for multi-tier manufacturers.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Airbus confirmed a coating-quality deviation affecting about 500 A321neo aircraft, with investigation extending into a subcontractor layer.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Automotive, machinery, plastics, glass and other Trakya suppliers plausibly face the same supplier-deviation/lot-containment workflow; local existence needs validation.

supporting_article_titles: National cargo theft blitz leads to arrests, $635K in recovered freight
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Cargo theft increasingly exploits identity/document handoffs and cross-dock/jurisdiction transitions; one recovered shipment used a fraudulent bill of lading and moved through several cross-docks.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: load tender → carrier/driver/document verification → pickup → cross-dock handoff → delivery → incident escalation
raw_opportunities.target_customer: freight brokers, shippers and warehouse/cross-dock operators
raw_opportunities.buyer: transport security, brokerage operations or warehouse manager
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: preserve a verifiable chain of custody and flag identity/document inconsistencies at each freight handoff
raw_opportunities.current_friction: handoff evidence is fragmented and fraudulent company/document identities can survive multiple transfers before anyone sees the full chain
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: shipment handoff ledger with party/document checklist, photo/reference evidence, exception flags and cross-dock custody timeline
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A chain-of-custody evidence desk for high-risk freight handoffs.
raw_opportunities.why_now: A coordinated US cargo-theft operation recovered $635K; a $600K transformer load had been moved via fraudulent bill of lading through several cross-docks.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: The Lüleburgaz-Çorlu-Çerkezköy industrial/logistics corridor plausibly has multi-carrier and warehouse handoffs; concrete local fraud evidence still needs validation.

supporting_article_titles: Fresh Data, Clear Access Rules: The Foundation For Reliable AI Applications
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: As AI agents connect directly to operational databases/documents, freshness, lineage and field-level access rules become runtime prerequisites rather than background data-governance concerns.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI use case → data-source inventory → freshness/lineage check → access approval → production connection → periodic review
raw_opportunities.target_customer: mid-market companies deploying internal AI/RAG/agent applications
raw_opportunities.buyer: data owner, IT/security lead or AI product owner
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: decide whether each data source is fresh, authoritative and permitted for a specific AI use case before connecting it
raw_opportunities.current_friction: data location, sensitivity, freshness and allowed AI uses are scattered across teams and added piecemeal at application level
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: AI data-access registry mapping use case to source, owner, sensitivity, freshness SLA, permitted fields, legal/compliance basis and review date
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight preflight registry for AI data access and freshness.
raw_opportunities.why_now: PhonePe and other CTOs described data freshness, lineage and element-level access controls as prerequisites for reliable AI at scale.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Manufacturers introducing internal AI over ERP/quality/maintenance documents face the same source-ownership and access-approval problem.

supporting_article_titles: Amaysim slugged with $138,600 penalty for unverified number ports
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: A small number of verification bypasses triggered a six-figure penalty plus independent review, quarterly full-population audits and board-approved compliance reporting.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: high-risk customer request → required identity check → override/exception → audit sample/full review → board/regulator report
raw_opportunities.target_customer: regulated service providers with staff override paths in identity-sensitive workflows
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: prove that manual overrides of mandatory verification were justified, reviewed and included in compliance reporting
raw_opportunities.current_friction: override permissions and evidence can bypass the normal digital control path and become visible only after incidents
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: verification-override register with reason/evidence, approver, affected transaction, periodic audit queue and board-report export
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A compliance evidence ledger for manual overrides of mandatory identity checks.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Amaysim paid A$138,600 after 13 ports lacked required verification and agreed to independent governance review and quarterly audits.

supporting_article_titles: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Quantum-safe TLS is moving from protocol planning toward certificate issuance, creating a concrete inventory/migration decision for organizations with many public endpoints.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: domain/service inventory → certificate/crypto dependency inventory → readiness classification → migration owner/date → evidence
raw_opportunities.target_customer: SMBs and agencies managing many domains and public web services
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: know which public services are ready for post-quantum TLS changes and track migration without a heavyweight PKI platform
raw_opportunities.current_friction: domain inventories, certificate issuers and application dependencies are often undocumented across small organizations
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: manual/imported endpoint inventory with crypto-readiness questionnaire, dependency/owner mapping, migration backlog and evidence export
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A post-quantum TLS migration readiness register for smaller organizations.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Cloudflare announced plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates, making migration readiness a nearer operational concern.

supporting_article_titles: Inside McDonald's push to have AI price your Big Mac
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: AI-driven local pricing can optimize store-level prices but creates franchisee pressure, deviation tracking, reputational risk and antitrust scrutiny around how recommendations are produced and followed.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: pricing recommendation → rule/rationale → franchisee accept/deviate → approval/evidence → consumer/regulatory review
raw_opportunities.target_customer: franchise networks and multi-location retailers using algorithmic pricing recommendations
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: document why a location-level algorithmic price recommendation was accepted or rejected and prove guardrails were followed
raw_opportunities.current_friction: pricing engines can use sensitivity/competitor signals while local operators face pressure and legal/reputation questions without a simple decision trail
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: algorithmic pricing decision ledger recording recommendation, allowed inputs/guardrails, operator decision, deviation reason, approval and periodic fairness/compliance review
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: An audit trail for human decisions around AI-generated location pricing.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Reuters reporting shows McDonald's AI pricing engine tracks local willingness-to-pay and franchisee deviations while the company warns of antitrust scrutiny.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Multi-location food/retail operators in Türkiye could use the same recommendation/deviation audit workflow; local algorithmic-pricing adoption requires validation.
